depth.description: Push-up depth measured by elbow interior flexion angle (lower is deeper)

torso_lean.description: Hip sag or arch away from straight rigid plank line

coaching_tips.shallow_depth: Lower your chest closer to the floor. Aim for at least 90-degree bend at your elbows.
coaching_tips.excessive_lean: Your hips are sagging. Squeeze your glutes and brace your core to maintain a straight plank.
coaching_tips.good_rep: Strong push-up! Full elbow extension at the top and chest-to-deck depth.
